zh-CN.title: 斗地主常驻活动
items: 空间管理员可领取斗地主常驻活动。认证成员可把牌桌分享到群聊，点击邀请即可加入。
牌桌支持加倍、出牌提示和托管，年度排行榜分为积分榜与胜率榜。

en.title: Dou Dizhu comes to your space
items: Space admins can enable Dou Dizhu. Verified members can share tables to group chats and tap the invitation to join.
The table supports doubling, hints and auto-play. Annual leaderboards track points and win rate.
